reuse.why: All providers, Fintegra included, go through one linkBankSyncAccount that keeps using findOrCreateBank and handleSyncResponse, and the takeover reuses a clearAccountLink extracted from unlinkAccount.

duplication.why: The six copied link bodies collapse into one definition and the unlink reset is shared; only downloadFintegraTransactions is a verbatim copy of downloadAkahuTransactions.

placement.why: The closed, already-linked and takeover rules sit in the shared linking definition before any bank row is written; Fintegra is typed as an ad-hoc 'AccountSyncSource | "fintegra"' instead of being added to SYNC_PROVIDERS.

scope.why: Every change serves the refactor or one of the four follow-up requests.

maintainability.why: Providers are thin adapters that state only their bank id, institution, account fields and real variations (fileId, syncEventTables), so future linking rules change in one place.

bypasses_abstraction.where: linkBankSyncAccount's syncSource is typed 'AccountSyncSource | "fintegra"' rather than extending the shared SYNC_PROVIDERS/AccountSyncSource definition

abstraction_drift.where: linkBankSyncAccount gains replaceExistingLink with a branch that clears the holder via clearAccountLink; the closed and duplicate-link rules are general checks, and all six handlers call it
